title: Lining.
officialText: Concrete and masonry chimneys shall be lined with an approved medium-duty refractory brick a minimum of 41/ inches (114 mm) thick laid on the 41/ -inch bed (114 mm) in an approved medium-duty refractory mortar. 2 2 The lining shall start 2 feet (610 mm) or more below the lowest chimney connector entrance. Chimneys terminating 25 feet (7620 mm) or less above a chimney connector entrance shall be lined to the top.
